 Lamb Chops Of Heaven Lamb Biryani Chicken Makhani/Butter Chicken Chicken Tikka Masala Paneer Tikka Masala Veg Samosa (2 Pieces) Boneless Chicken Biryani Welcome to Biryani PotBiryani Pot brings real Indian cooking to the heart of Mobile. Our restaurant was built with one clear goal: share the rich food culture of India with our local community. We follow traditional cooking methods and use trusted spices and herbs to create meals people remember. When you visit Biryani Pot, you can enjoy fresh food, friendly service, and a menu full of classic Indian favorites.Real Indian BiryaniBiryani is one of the most loved dishes in Indian cuisine. At Biryani Pot, it is the star of our kitchen. Our chefs cook it using time-tested methods that bring out deep flavor and texture in every bowl. Each dish is made with rice, spices, and carefully prepared ingredients. Guests in Mobile now have a place where they can explore authentic Indian biryani without traveling far.View Menu Order Online with EaseSkip the wait and order directly from our website. Browse the menu, choose your favorites, and place your order in just a few clicks. Fresh, delicious food—ready when you are.Order Now A Look Inside Our KitchenTake a quick look at the gallery and see our signature dishes. Each photo shows the care and tradition that goes into every meal we serve.Image galleryCloseCloseLet Us Cater Your Next EventBiryani Pot also offers catering for events of all sizes. Our catering menu is perfect for office lunches, family celebrations, birthdays, and community gatherings. We prepare large portions of our popular Indian dishes so guests can enjoy the same quality food outside the restaurant. Our team works with you to plan a menu that fits your event.Catering Info Comfortable Dine-In AtmosphereDining at Biryani Pot is easy and welcoming. Our team works hard to provide quick service and a clean, relaxed space where guests can enjoy their meals. It is a great place for lunch breaks, family dinners, or casual meals with friends. From the moment you walk in, our staff is ready to help you choose a dish and make your visit smooth and enjoyable.What our guests are saying★★★★★Yesterday we visited this restaurant and tried their buffet. The food was really good with a nice variety of dishes. Everything was fresh and tasty. The ambiance was pleasant and the staff were friendly and attentive. We had a great experience overall and would definitely visit again.

The atmosphere was great and inviting. The service was great also, he brought our food and taught us how to eat it!! I’m definitely going back!!
